body:
`README.md` has a broken Markdown link near the top:

> Visit [stampd.io](https;//stampd.io) to get your API credentials.

The URL scheme is mistyped as `https;//` (semicolon) instead of `https://`, so the link doesn't resolve. Fix it to `https://stampd.io`.

Docs-only, single-character correction — no code change.
title: docs: fix broken stampd.io link in README (https;// → https://)
